fixtures.name: st
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT k::INTEGER AS id,
  (CASE WHEN k % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (['héllo wörld','  padded  ','','日本語のテキスト','a','😀😀x','ABC def','  ','x  y','é','ǅ','tabs and','  lead','trail  ','aaa'])[1 + k % 15] END) AS s,
  (CASE WHEN k % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'v' || k::VARCHAR || (CASE WHEN k % 3 = 0 THEN ' ' ELSE '' END) || repeat('é', k % 4) || (CASE WHEN k % 11 = 0 THEN '😀' ELSE '' END) END) AS u,
  (k % 4)::INTEGER AS g,
  (CASE WHEN k % 6 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE k / 7.0 END)::DOUBLE AS d
FROM range(0, 3000) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)
